title: GridSim v1 onloadtapchanger.json
description: The on-load tap changers of the case, one record each. Optional file. Member names are case-sensitive here (canonical camelCase spelling), although the v1 loader matches them ignoring case: the case editor refuses to save a non-canonical spelling until it is normalised (Q1, strict). Unknown members are refused, as the loader refuses them (R268). JSON null is refused everywhere: the loader reads null as absent, and the editor removes a member rather than writing null. Numeric ranges mirror the v2 network schema, so a v1 case the editor saves always projects to a valid v2 network. Rules a schema cannot express (bus references resolving, ZIP triples summing to 1, the [VERIFY] honesty rule) are the loader's.

oltc.title: On-load tap changer
oltc.description: An on-load tap changer (v1 OltcDto) on the named transformer, regulating the voltage of a bus. The solver finds the transformer by name (and end bus), falling back to the first branch of that name (SteadyStateSolver.MapOltcRecordsToBranches); a name matching no branch is a loader warning. Absent: targetVpu 1, minTap 0.9, maxTap 1.1, stepPu 0.0125, deadbandPu 0.01.

transformer.title: Transformer
transformer.description: Name of the transformer (or branch) the tap changer sits on.

controlsBus.title: Controlled bus
controlsBus.description: The bus whose voltage is regulated (must exist in buses.json).

targetVpu.title: Target voltage (pu)
targetVpu.description: Voltage the tap changer regulates to. Absent: 1.0.

stepPu.title: Tap step (pu)
stepPu.description: Ratio change per tap step. Absent: 0.0125.

deadbandPu.title: Deadband (pu)
deadbandPu.description: Voltage band around the target inside which the tap does not move. Absent: 0.01.
